reviews.correction: Replace the everyday example and first_view example: reference requests test whether recalibration controls future error under changing conditions; they cannot causally distinguish drift from environmental change. Replace "Separate ..." in evaluation with "Report changing-condition performance without attributing causal contributions." Narrow closest-work difference: the cited Oct2026 paper already has reference-efficient and drift scenarios; the proposed distinction is sequential query/update policy at equal acquired-reference budget.

reviews.correction: Describe access failure as this investigation's observed route failure, not proof the public dataset is universally unavailable. Existing related methods do not themselves disqualify a master thesis; access is the operative gate.

reviews.correction: Explicitly require shared node-wise scoring or scenario-based inference for unseen-location evaluation. A fixed multiclass boosted classifier trained without particular location labels is not a meaningful unseen-location comparator; use seen-location episode tests for that baseline and a separately declared unseen-location test for transferable models. Keep coverage under shifted simulation empirical and confirm simulator feasibility before committing.

reviews.rationale: Preserving annotated short bouts is a defensible focused development/evaluation study despite close smoothing prior work. LTU EEG connection is adjacent.
reviews.correction: Retain the close StageGuard comparator and offline/context matching. Prefer a locally trained classifier for the clean main test if YASA training exposure cannot be excluded; any exposed pretrained result is secondary. Group nights and all uncertainty/model selection by person. No micro-arousal or clinical claim.

reviews.rationale: The current file already specifies patient-wise PTB-XL1-8/9/10, duplicate audit and masking only after splitting; this matches official PTB-XL guidance. Learned masks/dropout versus reconstruction is substantive; physiological-ML fit is adjacent.
reviews.correction: Change "Two electrodes fail" to "Two recorded lead channels are missing" unless electrode-to-derived-lead failure propagation is explicitly modeled. Split patients before every imputer/classifier/scaler fit; use identical frozen test masks across paired methods, and patient-cluster uncertainty. Account for total reconstruction+classifier parameters/compute when claiming matched budget. Downstream diagnostic evaluation is already in ImputeECG.

reviews.rationale: Public event/noise bytes and a small-model plan support a bounded feasibility gate. Weak specific LTU seismic-AI linkage supports lower priority, not an academic ineligibility claim.
reviews.correction: Clarify event-based calibration/validation distinct from final test; quality flags are training supervision only, not leaked test features. Report whether label-quality weights predict true noise or merely labeler/source strata. Keep 100-trace sample distinct from evidence that the larger selection pipeline is feasible.

reviews.rationale: Strongest ready direction: LTU staff page explicitly lists speech variability and audio classification supervision interests. Hard-negative selection with learned rejection and controlled comparisons is meaningful applied development without novel architecture.
reviews.correction: Keep speaker and unknown-word-type splits independent of mining and threshold tuning. Charge mining passes in total compute and use a feasible operating point with enough negatives. Preserve isolated-clip FPR wording, not false activations/hour. Do not imply staff commitment or demonstrated customer demand.

reviews.rationale: Direct LTU EEG/inner-speech research and prior-thesis connection is strongest institutionally. Actual data access is qualified; event alignment remains a legitimate prototype feasibility gate. The corrected methods explicitly acknowledge cue/task confounding.
reviews.correction: Retitle/reword all first-view claims as artifact sensitivity in visually cued EEG task-label classification, e.g. "Audit eye-movement effects in a cued EEG word task." Do not call surviving accuracy isolated imagined-word decoding or estimate a causal percentage due to ocular activity: visible words and inner speech overlap. Four participants require four reported outer folds and conservative descriptive uncertainty; freeze event reconciliation before training. Define whether held-out-subject unsupervised ICA uses only a permitted calibration period or is explicitly transductive; train-only learned corrections must not silently use test-person data.

reviews.rationale: Verified labelled public sample and publisher Apache2 declaration support access qualification. Signature-vs-text conditional classification and context/imbalance ablations are a specific learning study; detector mAP is correctly excluded. Full family inventory and sufficient rare independent families remain proper precommitment gates.
reviews.correction: Preserve natural signature/text prevalence on validation/test, or explicitly report sampling weights and target population. Training negative caps/class balancing must not silently inflate test PR-AUC or precision. Freeze candidate-region selection and report provided-box results separately from secondary proposal-based results. Family-disjoint split/grouping and parameter/compute equality are required, as already planned.
reviews.publication_action: Add one sentence clarifying unaltered evaluation prevalence; otherwise no blocker.
reviews.limits: Only200 decoded rows establish format/access; they do not validate signature-family diversity or the planned full subset. Context gate/contrastive loss is not established novelty or guaranteed useful.

reviews.rationale: Controlled multiclass boundary-noise learning, matched ignored-band/soft-label/hard-noise baselines, unchanged evaluation labels and bounded architecture form a substantive applied study. Three manuscripts permit three descriptive transfer cases, not broad population generalization; candidate correctly discloses this.
reviews.correction: Construct the learner's uncertain boundary band and plausible adjacent-class set exclusively from its coarsened observed TRAIN mask. The original clean mask may generate controlled corruption and supply a separately labeled clean-supervision upper baseline, but must not secretly inform the robust loss. Use source-only tuning per manuscript-held-out fold; primary within-manuscript experimentation must not select settings using the outer held-out source. Resolve palette/overlap class rules before training.
reviews.publication_action: Clarify supervision information available to each baseline before publication; no need to execute the pilot first.
reviews.limits: Public legacy private-test pair is format evidence only; do not turn it into development data. Page resampling describes within-source uncertainty; three sources cannot support population-wide writer claims. Corrupted boundaries are synthetic, not measured annotation-time savings.

publication_corrections_applied.ND5: Unseen-location evaluation requires shared node-wise scoring or scenario inference. Fixed multiclass trees are restricted to held-out episodes at known locations.
publication_corrections_applied.ND7: Missing recorded lead channels are distinct from physical electrode failures; the example and simulated-missingness claim now preserve that distinction.
publication_corrections_applied.ND10: Visible words prevent isolated inner-speech identification. The study is a cued-task classification/artifact audit; no causal fraction of thought decoding is claimed.
